stock.description: Smart Globe Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily engaged in the creation, printing, and distribution of a wide array of products, including books, distinctive novelty items, and packaging solutions. Its operational reach extends across significant global markets such as Hong Kong, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Australia, the People's Republic of China, and France, alongside broader international territories. The company provides a comprehensive suite of services throughout the printing lifecycle, from initial pre-press work and actual printing to final finishing, and also offers tailored and enhanced printing products. Its extensive product catalog features items like various box constructions, children's literature (including intricate pop-up books), journals, a diverse range of other book products, stationery, photo albums, leather goods, and large-format books. Established in 2012, the firm's main offices are located in North Point, Hong Kong, and it operates as a subsidiary of Master Sage Limited.
